name: MMStar
description: A benchmark of 1,500 elite vision-indispensable multimodal evaluation samples testing 6 core capabilities: coarse perception, fine-grained perception, instance reasoning, logical reasoning, science and technology knowledge, and mathematical reasoning. Strictly human-filtered to eliminate text-only solvable or data-leaked questions.
evaluation_method: accuracy; Multi-modal Gain (MMG) and Multi-modal Leakage (MML) metrics
reputation: Integrated into VLMEvalKit and OpenCompass evaluation frameworks; peer-reviewed benchmark addressing vision-necessity verification; key for honest LVLMs evaluation in 2025–2026
notes: Uses strict human filtering to ensure every question genuinely requires visual input — previous multimodal benchmarks had many questions solvable from text alone. Introduces Multi-modal Gain (MMG) and Multi-modal Leakage (MML) as diagnostic metrics. Integrated into VLMEvalKit and OpenCompass. Published 2024, accepted at ECCV.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China
